title: Universal Animation Library
summary: 45 humanoid clips by Quaternius (idle, walk, jog, sprint, crouch, jump, roll, swim, sit, punch, sword, pistol, spell, hit, death) and a script that retargets MPFB, Rigify, and Mixamo rigs to them.
useWhen: Humanoid 3D characters (from MPFB, Rigify, a Mixamo download, or another humanoid rig) need idle, locomotion, or combat animations, and animating each clip by hand in Blender would take too long.
avoidWhen: Non-humanoid creatures, 2D games, or a character whose model already holds the clips the game needs.
copyright: Animations by Quaternius; the import settings, bone maps, and retarget.gd that WASD Engine adds are also CC0-1.0
